build_orchestrator_agent: build an Orchestrator agent to manage docstring generation workflow for a given repository path
run_orchestrator_process: run the Orchestrator process method to generate and verify docstrings for a focal code component
parse_verifier_response: parse the verifier XML response into a structured dictionary with revision and context suggestions
update_context_with_search_results: update the internal and external context XML structure with new search results from the Searcher agent
constrain_context_length: constrain the context length by truncating the longest XML component to fit within max input token limits
